actionable_steps.citation: Education Should Foster Virtues In Students — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 29 (1996), 1996-07-23
actionable_steps.step: Fill your heart with love for God — then the sweet water of love will flow through the taps of the senses.

actionable_steps.citation: The youth should follow the path of sathya and dharma — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 39 (2006), 2006-05-27
actionable_steps.step: Follow the path of sathya and dharma, and take a firm resolve to set the world right.

actionable_steps.citation: Cultivate humanness and be an ideal to society — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 39 (2006), 2006-08-13
actionable_steps.step: Conserve the divine energy of your senses — don't waste money and don't waste food, for food is God.

actionable_steps.citation: Education For Supreme Bliss — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 33 (2000), 2000-11-22
actionable_steps.step: Start early — what will you gain if you waste all your energy in youth and start thinking about God only in old age?

actionable_steps.citation: Sanctify Your Life With Sacred Feelings — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 33 (2000), 2000-03-05
actionable_steps.step: Cultivate love — whatever you do, do it with the spirit of love, for without love all actions become unsacred.

definition.citation: Sanctify Your Life With Sacred Feelings — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 33 (2000), 2000-03-05
definition.quote: You should foster such ideals and for that youth is the right age. It is the golden age. This sacred age should not be put to misuse. Utilise it in the right way.

discourses.citation: The youth should follow the path of sathya and dharma — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 39 (2006), 2006-05-27
discourses.quote: Only the youth are capable of protecting this world. It is the youth and youth alone who can set this world right. … If they take a firm resolve, they are capable of achieving anything.

discourses.citation: Fill the world with love — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 28 (1995), 1995-11-18
discourses.quote: Youth is not related to age. … Youthhood should be dedicated to purposeful activities.

discourses.citation: Education Should Foster Virtues In Students — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 29 (1996), 1996-07-23
discourses.quote: The period of youth is most important and sacred. It is, in fact, the golden age. Don't turn this golden age into dust. … First of all, fill your heart with love for God.

discourses.citation: Seek God within — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 32 (1999), 1999-11-21
discourses.quote: Young men and women, future citizens of the world! The future of the world, good or bad, depends on your conduct. … What the world needs today is not affluence and material comforts but men and women of noble character.

make_it_real: Youth is your golden age — don't turn it into dust; fill it with God.
title: Youth

vahinis.quote: The remedy lies in a mind, in a heart filled with holiness. Holiness must take root and grow in the minds and hearts of youth everywhere, of boys and girls and of children.
